environment.description: ECS Fargate task in private subnet. Task role arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/app-task-role-prod has the same AdministratorAccess policy BUT is subject to IAM permission boundary arn:aws:iam::555666777888:policy/BoundaryEnforceMinimalCompute which uses an explicit Deny with StringNotEquals condition on aws:RequestedRegion and denies sts:AssumeRole, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue, ssm:SendCommand, lambda:InvokeFunction, ec2:RunInstances, iam:*, s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject for all resources. The SCP on the OU (ou-abc1-prodworkloads) additionally has a Deny for organizations:LeaveOrganization and iam:DeleteRolePermissionsBoundary preventing boundary removal. Container runs as non-root uid 1000. NAT gateway egress is filtered by prefix list allowing only AWS service endpoints (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.*) via VPC endpoints - no general internet egress. Note: the text/template SSTI is still reachable but command execution results cannot be exfiltrated and AWS API calls from the task role are denied by the permission boundary for any dangerous action.

config.network: private subnet, VPC endpoints only, no IGW, no NAT to internet
